question: The value of {(3)/(4) of 60 ÷ 9} × 0.02 is:
solution:
**Concept used:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b98049e03feb8065ac70d1d1e534ff56cd12464a4f43944b76f5d91a4dcfaad0.png] 

**Calculation:**

{(3)/(4) of 60 ÷ 9} × 0.02

⇒ {45 ÷ 9} × 0.02

⇒ 5 × 0.02 = 0.10

**∴ The correct answer is 0.10.**
